call_points.text: Management expects FY27 consolidated revenue growth in mid-teens.
Net debt to EBITDA expected to drop below 2x in FY27 and eventually to 1.5x.
March exit run rate for alloy wheels was ~3 million annualized, expected to reach 4 million next year.
Powertrain stationary engine order book for first $100 million is finalized for delivery by FY29-FY30.
Sunbeam turnarounds ongoing via exiting non-profitable products, customers, and unviable legacy pricing.
DR Axion greenfield Sriperumbudur project construction is ongoing, commissioning targeted by December.
Management flagged rising labor and operating costs across plants as a major focus area.

operating_notes.text: Acquired 100% equity of Suprash Developers Private Limited and Srikara Technologies Private Limited for ₹145.85 Cr.
March 2026 exit run rate for alloy wheels reached ~3 million units annualized against 5.5 million total capacity.
Powertrain capacity utilization stands at ~60-65%, providing 20-25% headroom on conventional lines.
Powertrain capacity utilisation is around 70%, seen hard to exceed 75% annually due to seasonality; Aluminium is above 80%.
Alloy wheel installed capacity is 5.8 million units, with 4 million expected this year across Bhiwadi and Shoolagiri.
Current depreciation is close to ₹500 Cr, with ₹250-300 Cr of maintenance capex needed to replace machinery.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹2,226.4 Cr (+27.3% YoY), net profit ₹116.42 Cr (+74.4% YoY).
Craftsman Automation reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,226.4 Cr and recommended a final dividend of ₹11.25 per share.
Craftsman Automation Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings conference call on 8 May 2026 at 4:00 PM (IST) for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website.
Craftsman Automation held its Q4FY26 earnings call, guiding for mid-teens FY27 revenue growth and targeting $1B aluminium revenue in 2-3 years.
Craftsman Automation board approved an enabling resolution to raise up to ₹2,000 Cr via fundraise options and called an EGM for June 13, 2026.

Shainshad Aduvanni, Craftsman Automation Limited, held one-on-one physical meetings with UTI Mutual Fund, Nippon Mutual Fund, and Enam Holdings on 21 May 2026, sharing no unpublished price-sensitive information.
Craftsman Automation Limited’s Shainshad Aduvanni met HSBC, Tata, Amansa, ICICI Prudential, Edelweiss, SBI Life, and SBI Mutual Funds on 22 May 2026 for one-on-one physical meetings.
Shainshad Aduvanni, Craftsman Automation Limited, held one-on-one physical meetings with Hara Global, Carmignac, Federated Hermes, and T Rowe Price on 28 May 2026.
Shainshad Aduvanni, Craftsman Automation Limited, met Baroda BNP Mutual Fund on June 1, 2026, via one-on-one physical meeting from 11:00 AM to 12:00 PM IST.

Shainshad Aduvanni, Company Secretary, held one-on-one physical meetings with HDFC Life, Wasatch, 360 One, Canara Mutual Fund, and HDFC Mutual Fund on 2026-06-03 without disclosing unpublished price-sensitive information.
Shainshad Aduvanni, Craftsman Automation Limited, held a one-on-one virtual meeting with First Sentier on June 4, 2026, from 3:15 PM to 4:15 PM IST.

Shainshad Aduvanni, Director of Craftsman Automation Limited, held one-on-one physical meetings with GIC, Arohi, Nippon, and Nomura AM on 8 June 2026, sharing no unpublished price-sensitive information.
